test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which sector of Central Reserve Police Force will be headed by Inspector General Seema Dhundiya as announced in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As announced in **November 2022**, Inspector General **Seema Dhundiya** will head the sector of** Central Reserve Police Force** in **Bihar.**
 
• IG Seema Dhundia is renowned for providing services in India's most **delicate locations.**
 
• She took an active part in training the **CRPF's 2nd Mahila Battalion.**
 
• In the **UN Mission in Liberia**, she held the position of **contingent commander** for the first-ever all-female Formed Police Unit (FPU).
 
• She was in the **Rapid Action Force **(RAF) as the DIG till recently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Seema Dhundiya and** Annie Abraham,** two female officials, were recently elevated to the position of Inspector General.

 
 
• The **Rapid Action Force** (RAF) will be commanded by** IG Annie Abraham.**
 
• IG Annie Abraham oversaw the **United Nations Mission in Liberia's** (UNMIL) all-female FPU.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand**: The Central Reserve Police Force has **five sectors** in Jharkhand, and each sector is headed by an Inspector General.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**: The Central Reserve Police Force has **six sectors** in Uttar Pradesh, and each sector is headed by an Inspector General.
 
• **Rajasthan:** The Central Reserve Police Force has **two sectors** in Rajasthan, and each sector is headed by an Inspector General.
